introduction.summary: This specification records the project purpose, stakeholder constraints and unresolved decisions stated in the source evidence below.

items.title: Stakeholder project context
items.detail: Build a campus wireless network access-control requirements specification.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-002
items.detail: Students and guests may access the internet but must not access the internal staff network.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-003
items.detail: Network administrators may manually isolate a device and restore its access.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-004
items.detail: Security operators may review and acknowledge alerts but may not change access policies.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-005
items.detail: The system must record administrator policy changes and retain audit records for 30 days.

items.title: Unresolved stakeholder decision
items.detail: The planning population is 2000 registered devices; concurrency is not yet decided.

items.title: Out of scope: stakeholder exclusion
items.detail: Do not automatically change firewall rules or isolate devices.

items.title: Stakeholder project context
items.detail: Requirements evolve frequently and stakeholders provide weekly stakeholder feedback.

items.title: Unresolved stakeholder decision
items.detail: Budget, delivery schedule, response-time thresholds and mandatory regulatory frameworks are undecided and must remain open decisions.

open_issues: What is the defined concurrency level for device access?
How will frequent requirement changes be tracked and managed in the development lifecycle?
Which specific regulatory frameworks may apply to this campus network?
What is the acceptable response time for policy change detection or alert review?
How will device isolation actions be validated before restoration?
The planning population is 2000 registered devices; concurrency is not yet decided.
Budget, delivery schedule, response-time thresholds and mandatory regulatory frameworks are undecided and must remain open decisions.

functional.applicability_reason: Source-backed obligations; unspecified decisions remain open.

requirements.title: Students and guests may access the internet but must not access the internal staff network.
requirements.statement: Students and guests may access the internet but must not access the internal staff network.

acceptance_criteria.given: A student device connected to the public network
acceptance_criteria.when: The student attempts to access the internet
acceptance_criteria.then: The request is granted and connectivity is established
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: Test capture of successful internet access response

acceptance_criteria.given: A guest device connected to the public network
acceptance_criteria.when: The guest attempts to access the internal staff network
acceptance_criteria.then: The request is denied and no connection is established
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: Test capture of firewall denial packet for internal staff network

unresolved_decisions: Whether 'access' implies only direct connectivity or includes proxy-based routes

requirements.title: Network administrators may manually isolate a device and restore its access.
requirements.statement: Network administrators may manually isolate a device and restore its access.

acceptance_criteria.given: An administrator with valid credentials and a device under management
acceptance_criteria.when: The administrator initiates manual isolation of the device via console interface
acceptance_criteria.then: The device is isolated and status changes to 'isolated' in system state
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: Test capture of device isolation command execution and resulting state update

acceptance_criteria.given: An administrator with valid credentials and a device under management
acceptance_criteria.when: The administrator initiates manual restoration of access to the device
acceptance_criteria.then: Access is restored and device status changes to 'active'
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: Test capture of access restoration command execution and resulting state update

unresolved_decisions: Whether restoration must be confirmed by a second operator or audit log

requirements.title: Do not automatically change firewall rules or isolate devices.
requirements.statement: Do not automatically change firewall rules or isolate devices.

acceptance_criteria.given: A test device in active network state with no prior isolation
acceptance_criteria.when: The system attempts to automatically isolate the device via scheduled rule update or trigger event
acceptance_criteria.then: No isolation occurs and the device remains in active state
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: Test capture of firewall configuration before and after; no change detected

acceptance_criteria.given: A test device with active connection and configured rules
acceptance_criteria.when: The system attempts to automatically modify firewall rules to restrict access
acceptance_criteria.then: No rule modification occurs and the existing rules remain unchanged
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: Test capture of firewall configuration before and after; no change detected

unresolved_decisions: Whether automatic actions are triggered by specific events (e.g., traffic anomalies) or time-based schedules

nonfunctional.applicability_reason: Existing canonical requirements, where applicable, are linked below; this section adds no separate obligation. Unresolved stakeholder decisions remain open.
